title: Fixed-rank totient curvature: extremal-ordering socket, primitive affine kernel, and clean-LCM divisibility

concepts.label: fixed-rank totient curvature
concepts.note: The integral three-point second difference across the ranks H+j, 2H+j, and 3H+j.

concepts.label: middle-rank totient extremality
concepts.note: The strict local-minimum or strict local-maximum socket for the middle totient.

concepts.label: affine rank-three kernel
concepts.note: Integer coefficient triples annihilating the constant and linear moments.

concepts.label: primitive second-difference vector
concepts.note: The coefficient vector (1,-2,1), unique up to integer scaling in the affine kernel.

concepts.label: clean power-two-LCM offset
concepts.note: A positive offset j satisfying j^2<=2^a at the height periodLcm(2^a).

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: fixedRankSecondDifference H j is the integer φ(3H+j)-2φ(2H+j)+φ(H+j).
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project coordinate definition.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition supplies no sign, nonvanishing, divisibility, asymptotic bound, certificate, or progress on Erdős #249.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: MiddleRankTotientExtremal H j means that φ(2H+j) is strictly below both outer totients or strictly above both.
open_antecedents: for fixed j, cofinal occurrence of MiddleRankTotientExtremal at H=periodLcm(2^a), represented by the unproved PowerTwoLcmMiddleRankExtremalSupply j
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The declaration only names the project-local ordering predicate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Defining the socket does not assert it at any actual LCM height; sign and nonzero consequences are separate theorems.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every integer triple annihilating the constant and linear moments has c1=c3, c2=-2c3, and l1 norm 4|c3|.
statement_nodes.engine: elementary integer linear classification of the affine kernel
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is elementary integer linear algebra, with no number-theoretic novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Kernel uniqueness gives no information about whether the associated totient curvature is nonzero and supplies no extra two-adic factor.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a at least four, j positive, and j^2<=2^a, the integer 2φ(j) divides fixedRankSecondDifference (periodLcm(2^a)) j.
statement_nodes.engine: clean LCM factorization plus parity of the primitive curvature factor
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: No external priority or novelty claim is made for the exact divisibility statement.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Divisibility does not prove nonzero curvature, the extremal supply, a residue certificate, or irrationality. It does not imply stronger two-adic divisibility.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The fixed-rank second difference uses the primitive classified coefficient vector obtained by setting c3=1, namely (1,-2,1).
The two strict-minimum inequalities force positive curvature and the two strict-maximum inequalities force negative curvature, as proved by the adjacent source theorems.
The divisibility theorem restricts the general curvature to clean offsets at power-two LCM heights and proves an arithmetic property of that specialization.
Divisibility constrains the size lattice of the curvature, while the open extremal-ordering socket would provide independent nonvanishing.
